title: HtmlThead
responsibility: Renders the native thead element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlThead.attributes
inputs.description: Native thead attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlThead.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native thead element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlThead
outputs.description: The actual native thead element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
